note: Part of the air family: wings of fliers (swift fliers, fire-fliers, support fliers) kept at eyries and in the Roost (the pool of idle fliers), their missions, flights (groups of wings), riders of note, wing-ships (the carrier role), fire-bolts and the strategic air view. Terms come from the glossary; coined here: Roost, Flight, Wing-Ship, Sky Sighting, Beacon Reach, Sky Attack, Sky Defence, Rider Drills, Fire Raid, Deep Raid, fire-bolt site.
